note: nft is not installed. There is no payload because there was nothing to read, and that is the whole point of the variant: a decline of absent is a successful reading that commits zero objects, where unauthorised, unavailable and unsupported would leave prior state stale. payloads/ carries only a .gitkeep — git does not track empty directories, and a checkout without the directory would read as a broken corpus rather than an absent interface.
anchors_note: Staged truth: the guest genuinely had no nft binary, so the reading that retires prior objects is a decline of absent — any other reason would be the collector inventing an inability it did not have. nft-tables added 2026-08-23 with the R3d port: no ruleset is staged here, so the collection declines absent exactly as nft-chains does.
